hsv_lut.description: 2D_LUT table: 1.hsv_2d_hue_lut:Each row is sequentially incremented. 2.hsv_2d_sat_lut:Each column is sequentially incremented. 3.hsv_2d_hue_lut_reg:Corresponds to the value of hue under the sat index. 4.y_blending_factor:Controls the blending of brightness with the original image.
